name: pubdata-mcp
description: Eight free public-data tools for any MCP-capable agent: weather, earthquakes, ISS, moon, aircraft, gas, postcard.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Current conditions and 24h forecast for a lat/lon.

tools.name: get_earthquakes
tools.description: Recent quakes filterable by magnitude and time window.

tools.name: get_iss_position
tools.description: Where the ISS is right now.

tools.name: get_aircraft
tools.description: Aircraft broadcasting ADS-B near a point.

tools.name: get_postcard
tools.description: A human-readable summary of conditions at a place.

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Health and uptime of the upstream API.
